row.notes: (subscriptions obj): walks the 0xa0-byte records +0x168..+0x170; returns 1 when a record's name (+0x60) is 'ORIGIN_ACCESS', 'EA_ACCESS', 'Origin Access' or 'EA Access' and its state (+0x88) is 'ACTIVE' (strcmp 0x14535d850); also 1 when byte +0x14c is set; else 0. Called e.g. by 0x14078e1a0, 0x1407622c0, 0x143883960. (lane owner review requested)
